title: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate
question:
Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to status = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(status = 'Banned'))

prediction.sql: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.XCL_003) AS card_names FROM legalities AS "l" JOIN cards AS "c" ON "l".XCL_086 = "c".XCL_072 WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'Banned' AND l.XCL_084 = (SELECT XCL_084 FROM legalities WHERE XCL_085 = 'Banned' GROUP BY XCL_084 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

arguments.sql:
SELECT l.XCL_084, c.XCL_003
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
  AND l.XCL_084 = (
    SELECT XCL_084
    FROM legalities
    WHERE XCL_085 = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY XCL_084
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.XCL_003) AS card_names
FROM legalities l
